description:
Port test/compaction-extensions.test.ts (~10 test cases) + test/compaction-extensions-example.test.ts. Exercises:
- session_before_compact event with preparation data
- session_compact event with compaction entry result
- Extension cancellation of compaction
- Custom compaction provision (replaces default)
- Error handling (falls back to default on extension error)
- Multiple extension ordering
- Context access (sessionManager, modelRegistry)

Requires the test harness (ticket 1). Compaction events may not yet exist in the Elixir extension event types.
title: Port compaction extension tests (cancel, custom compaction, error fallback)
